summary:
ASTRA HEALTH is an astronaut health monitoring system designed to support astronaut safety and well-being during space missions. The platform simulates continuous health monitoring by tracking vital signs, monitoring health conditions, and identifying potential medical risks. It features an interactive mission dashboard, astronaut health profiles, simulated real-time health data, intelligent health alerts, and a dedicated space radiation monitoring system.
A key feature is its radiation monitoring module, which tracks radiation exposure levels, visualizes exposure trends, identifies potential radiation risks, and provides alerts when exposure reaches concerning thresholds. This helps astronauts and mission teams better understand radiation hazards and take appropriate precautions.
ASTRA HEALTH addresses the challenge of developing health monitoring software for astronauts by combining health monitoring and radiation risk awareness in one accessible platform. It is important because astronauts face unique health threats from microgravity and space radiation. Early detection, continuous monitoring, and timely alerts can support better medical decisions, protect crew health, and contribute to safer space missions.
details:
Project Details – ASTRA HEALTH

ASTRA HEALTH is an astronaut health monitoring platform designed to improve crew safety and health awareness during space missions. It provides a centralized dashboard where mission teams can monitor astronaut health, track vital signs, review health trends, and identify potential medical risks.

How It Works

The platform uses simulated astronaut health data to demonstrate continuous health monitoring. It tracks important health indicators, displays individual astronaut health profiles, and generates alerts when readings move beyond defined safety thresholds. Its dedicated radiation monitoring module tracks radiation exposure levels, visualizes exposure trends, highlights potential radiation hazards, and provides alerts when exposure reaches concerning levels. This allows users to understand both medical and environmental risks during a simulated space mission.

Benefits

  • Centralized monitoring of astronaut health information.
  • Early identification of abnormal vital signs.
  • Radiation exposure tracking and risk awareness.
  • Visual health dashboards and mission monitoring.
  • Alerts that support faster awareness and decision-making.
  • Improved understanding of astronaut health risks in space.

Intended Impact

Our goal is to demonstrate how digital health monitoring can support astronaut safety during long-duration space missions. ASTRA HEALTH aims to help mission teams recognize potential health concerns earlier, understand radiation exposure risks, and make more informed decisions to protect crew members.

Tools and Technologies

The project was developed as a software-based prototype using web development technologies, programming tools, and AI-assisted development. Our team used ChatGPT and other AI tools to support coding, research, problem-solving, and documentation. The system uses simulated data to demonstrate its monitoring and alert capabilities without requiring physical medical sensors or specialized hardware.

Creativity and Innovation

The distinctive aspect of ASTRA HEALTH is the integration of astronaut health monitoring with a dedicated radiation exposure monitoring feature. Rather than focusing only on vital signs, it also considers the environmental hazards astronauts face beyond Earth. Combining health indicators, radiation trends, and alerts in one interface provides a more comprehensive view of astronaut well-being.

Factors Considered

During development, our team considered astronaut safety, the unique challenges of microgravity, space radiation exposure, ease of use, clear visualization of health information, timely alerts, and the importance of making the prototype simple and accessible for mission teams. We also considered the limited development time and focused on building a practical, demonstrable solution that could be expanded in the future.
